queue.title: Engagement probe: detect Kysely/Knex query builder write patterns
queue.description: (added ~s725): With Drizzle and Prisma now covered, the remaining ORM blind spot is raw query builders — Kysely (`db.insertInto().values()`, `db.updateTable().set()`) and Knex (`knex('table').insert()`, `knex('table').update()`). These are common in lightweight SSR stacks.

outcome.note: Added 6 Kysely/Knex write patterns with chain-aware regex. 12 new tests, all 82 pass.

queue.title: What-if scenario diffing with queue snapshots
queue.description: Extend what-if compare to diff full queue snapshots — show items changed between scenarios, flag stale scenarios where queue has changed since save.

queue.title: Add version extraction for Svelte framework
queue.description: Svelte is detected by FRAMEWORK_PATTERNS but has no VERSION_EXTRACTOR. Add pattern for Svelte CDN URLs (e.g. svelte@5.5.0) and/or SvelteKit __sveltekit markers with version. Follows wq-1083 pattern.

queue.title: Test computeBackupSubstitutionRate with mocked engagement traces
queue.description: (added ~s724): Similar to wq-1080 pattern — `computeBackupSubstitutionRate` reads trace files from STATE_DIR. Adding `stateDir` override param would enable integration tests with synthetic trace data covering edge cases like empty archives, all-substitution sessions, and platform distribution.
